How can I pay my balance?
• Sign in to Your MyChart account
• Online https://www.seasidehs.example and click on Pay My Bill
• Use the coupon above to pay by mail. If you have a balance due with both areas the payment will be split 50/50 between your Hospital and Physician Balances
• Call us at (954) 555-0142
• Payments Plans can be set up in MyChart, online or by phone
• If you would like to apply for financial assistance please call us at the number above. To view our Financial Assistance Policy, visit our website: www.seasidehs.example/financialaid.
